title: 第2700章 逆天境第2699章 逆天献祭
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
嗖！
随着空间通道碎裂，罗老八和罗四喜两人的身影，消失在他视线之中。
一瞬间，绝望感涌上心头。
灵皇不知道，这两人到底是成功抵达了罗天所在的空间，还是被卷入空间乱流了。
“怎么会这样？”灵皇诧异的抬起头来，看向半空之中。
这一看之下，灵皇瞳孔巨震，整个魂体都险些崩溃。
就见半空之中，满天大道道果已经溶解，化作无数天地规则，汇聚成三千河流，流淌进了“魔千秋”的身体。
魔千秋体内，威压不断暴涨，牵动着整个天地，让四周的一切规则，都变得不稳定。
而在那些宛如河流的天地规则另一头，元灵不灭城城主化作的道道光点，还在试图阻止。
然而，他的力量，在“魔千秋”面前，显得如此微不足道。
看到这里，灵皇全都明白了！
原来，这场属于逆天之子的争斗，“魔千秋”已经接近胜利，而且还是以压倒性的优势，取得了胜利。
他距离突破逆天境，成为逆天之子，已经只差一点。
而这个突破的过程，干扰了天地规则，才让那空间通道破碎。
“可恶，都结束了么……”灵皇暗叹了一声，绝望的闭上眼。
在他看来，哪怕罗老八和罗四喜两人，成功找到了罗天，也已经来不及了。
空间通道被破坏，“魔千秋”突破就要完成。
罗天就算知道，也没有办法及时赶回！
这天地，难道要以这个荒唐的方式结束了？
另一边，“魔千秋”睁开眼，他看着那些不断流淌入自己体内的天地规则，还有渐渐向自己臣服的混乱天雾，唇角挂上了一丝笑意。

“小辈，这些年辛苦你了！若不是你，凭我现在的状态，想要重新凑齐这突破的仪式，可能还要往后拖几个纪元才行！为此，我可以给你一个恩典！只要你现在，将一缕灵魂交给我，我可以让你成为我的逆天奴！”
“成了我的逆天奴之后，你不仅能保住现在的性命，甚至还能拥有混乱天雾的一点权柄，让你的实力，不会下降太多，如何？”
听着他挑衅般的声音，元灵不灭城城主含恨道：“你……妄想，我还有失败！”
他说话间，那些光点闪烁，试图将三千大道，从对方体内抽离出来。
呼！
就连“魔千秋”身上的混乱天雾，也开始躁动起来。
不过，这“魔千秋”眉头一皱，随手一指点来。
呼！
那刚刚流淌滞涩的三千大道，迅速恢复了正常，继续朝着他体内流淌而去。
而原本躁动的混乱天雾，也安静了下来。
“小辈，何必呢？你应该知道我是什么人！我曾经掌握完整的混乱天雾，论对混乱天雾的掌控，你和我根本不在一个层次上！这是先天的压制，就算你再这么努力，也是没有意义的！”
他说到这里，脸上忽然挂上一丝冷漠，继续道：“不过呢，为了以防万一……”
说话间，他双手结印。
轰隆隆！
一瞬间，他身上混乱天雾翻涌。
紧跟着，元灵不灭城城主化作的无数光点，忽然剧烈的颤抖起来。
砰、砰、砰……
更是有不少光电，直接碎裂开来。
“你……你做了什么？”一个个光点之中，传来了元灵不灭城城主惊恐的声音。
“魔千秋”闻言，笑着说道：“没什么，我只是将你在混乱天雾上的所有印记，全都抹除了！”
content_en:
Whoosh!
As the space passage shattered, the figures of Luo Laoba and Luo Sixi disappeared from his sight.
For a moment, a feeling of despair came over me.
The Spirit Emperor didn't know whether the two men successfully reached Luo Tian's space or were involved in the turbulence of space.
"How could this happen?" The Spirit Emperor raised his head in surprise and looked into the air.
At this glance, the Spirit Emperor's pupils were trembling, and his entire soul almost collapsed.
I saw that in mid-air, the Dao Dao Fruit all over the sky had dissolved, turned into countless rules of heaven and earth, gathered into three thousand rivers, and flowed into the body of "Mo Qianqiu".
The pressure in Mo Qianqiu's body continued to surge, affecting the entire world and making all the rules around him unstable.
On the other side of the river-like rules of heaven and earth, the lord of Yuanling Immortal City turned into spots of light, still trying to stop them.
However, his power seemed so insignificant in front of "Mo Qianqiu".
Seeing this, the Spirit Emperor understood everything!
It turned out that "Mo Qianqiu" was close to victory in this battle that belonged to the Son of Heaven, and he still won with an overwhelming advantage.
He is only a little bit away from breaking through the Heaven-Defying Realm and becoming the Son of Heaven-Defying.
And this breakthrough process interfered with the rules of heaven and earth, causing the space channel to break.
"Damn it, is it all over..." The Spirit Emperor sighed secretly and closed his eyes in despair.
In his opinion, even if Luo Laoba and Luo Sixi succeeded in finding Luo Tian, ​​it would be too late.
The space channel is destroyed, and the "Magic Qianqiu" breakthrough is about to be completed.
Even if Luo Tian knew, there was no way he could get back in time!
Is this world going to end in this ridiculous way?
On the other side, "Mo Qianqiu" opened his eyes. He looked at the rules of heaven and earth that were constantly flowing into his body, and the chaotic Tianwu that gradually surrendered to him, with a smile on his lips.
"Junior, I have worked hard for you all these years! If it weren't for you, with my current state, if I want to put together this breakthrough ritual again, I might have to delay it for several epochs! For this, I can give you a grace! As long as you give me a ray of your soul now, I can make you my heaven-defying slave!"
"After becoming my Nitian Slave, not only can you keep your current life, but you can even have some authority over Chaos Tianwu, so that your strength will not drop too much, how about that?"
Listening to his provocative voice, the Lord of Yuanling Immortal City said with hatred: "You... are delusional, and I still failed!"
As he spoke, those light spots flickered, trying to pull the three thousand avenues out of the other party's body.
call!
Even the Chaos Tianwu on "Mo Qianqiu" began to stir.
However, this "Mo Qianqiu" frowned and pointed casually.
call!
The three thousand avenues that had just flowed stagnantly quickly returned to normal and continued to flow into his body.
And Tianwu, who was originally restless and chaotic, also calmed down.
"Junior, why bother? You should know who I am! I once mastered the complete Chaotic Sky Fog. In terms of controlling the Chaotic Sky Fog, you and I are not at the same level at all! This is innate suppression. No matter how hard you try, it will be meaningless!"
When he said this, a hint of indifference suddenly appeared on his face, and he continued: "But, just in case..."
As he spoke, he formed a seal with his hands.
Boom!
In an instant, chaos and mist surged around him.
Immediately afterwards, the countless light spots transformed into the Lord of Yuanling Immortal City suddenly began to tremble violently.
Bang, bang, bang...
There were even a lot of photoelectrics that shattered into pieces.
"You...what have you done?" The frightened voice of the Lord of Yuanling Immortal City came from the light spots.
"Mo Qianqiu" heard this and said with a smile: "Nothing, I just erased all your marks on Chaos Tianwu!"
